cross_correspondent_knowledge.scope: Gray’s indigenous and introduced stocks of the same species. Darwin’s memory that imported stock prevails is explicitly tentative and is not asserted as a verbatim or proven Gray conclusion.
cross_correspondent_knowledge.rationale: 2169 names Asa Gray and a letter he cannot consult, matches 2053 P17–20 introduced/aboriginal distinction, and apparatus identifies February 16. Upper bound is conservative from before November 12, not an exact composition or arrival date.

evidence.quote: How I distinguish the introduced & aboriginal stocks of the same species
because they were already a part of the indigenous flora!
Dr. Asa Gray, believes that in the United States there are several plants now naturalised in abundance from imported seed, which are likewise indigenous;
my impression is (but writing from home I cannot refer to his letter to me) that the imported stock prevails over the aboriginal.
